pages_read.title: KEPCO reports another massive data breach, exposing info of 1.52 million people

updated.what: Added Korea Herald as fourth source: KEPCO launched an investigation in cooperation with the National Intelligence Service, government agencies and outside experts (summary and validation note); evidence quote for 'around 1.52 million'. Summary tightened to 75 words.

open_leads.title: KEPCO SRM breach breakdown: 426,827 corporate representatives and 442,934 KEPCO and company employees
open_leads.note: Korea Herald gives the SRM breakdown but describes the representatives' exposed fields inconsistently (phone numbers in one paragraph, registration numbers in another); not added until KEPCO's own notice can be read.

notes: Korea Herald also mentions an earlier KEPCO breach a month before (35,528 people); q.mjs find KEPCO shows no such event on file, but it is outside the map window.
